name: @antiphony/core-api
description: Antiphony core HTTP service (Hono). Serves the public /api/v1/* surface as a standalone deployment — see specs/core-surface.md.

scripts.//dev: Needs DATABASE_URL in .dev.vars (gitignored) pointing at a Postgres — there is no Hyperdrive binding, so the database is a plain secret. Without it the graph has no database and the first request throws.
scripts.//check:worker-bundle: Bundles the Worker and fails if a Node-only dependency is in it. Not covered by typecheck, tests, or `wrangler deploy` — all three are happy to ship a bundle that cannot run. See the script.
scripts.//build: Only regenerates the OpenAPI documents now. The Node bundle went with src/index.ts — `wrangler deploy` bundles the Worker itself, and `check:worker-bundle` is what guards that artifact.
scripts.//validate:pins: Deploy-time gate: proves every ANTIPHONY_APP_DIDS pin against its did:web document before anything ships. Mechanism 1 of the boot-gate replacement — see the script.
scripts.//generate:service-key: Prints a new P-256 key for Antiphony's DID document (/.well-known/did.json): the private key for `wrangler secret put ANTIPHONY_SERVICE_SIGNING_KEY` and the public Multikey for the ANTIPHONY_SERVICE_PUBLIC_KEY var. Stdout only, writes no file; run it where the output is not logged.
scripts.//migrate: Applies migrations/*.sql to whatever DATABASE_URL points at, with a schema_migrations ledger, per-file transactions and checksums. See the script, and db/README.md for how to write a new migration. `-- --baseline` is the one-time adoption step for a database that already has 0001.
